sources.quote: HD 156411 is a 7th magnitude G-type subgiant star located approximately 182 light-years away in the southern constellation Ara.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 2.4 solar radii and 1.33 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,806 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
